context_requirements: Functional HCRTR1/HCRTR2 expression; orexin receptors are predominantly neuronal and are not expected to be expressed at meaningful levels in these nine non-neuronal cancer lines.
An intact orexin signaling axis capable of coupling to Gq/Gi and downstream transcriptional effectors; absent in most peripheral cancer cell lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h after 10 micromolar orexin receptor antagonist treatment in any of the nine lines.
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and consistent with HCRTR1/HCRTR2 engagement.
Evidence of HCRTR1 or HCRTR2 expression and functional signaling in these lines that correlates with a transcriptional response.
